news.title: Launch-weekend estimate: 44.9M copies, ~$4B gross
news.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates GTA 6 sold 44.9 million copies with ~$4 billion gross by the end of launch weekend — twice Taylor Swift's entire Eras Tour take.

news.title: Official: $3.79B day-one retail sales, 32.5M units pre-release
news.summary: Take-Two's press release confirms the biggest entertainment launch in history across any medium.

news.title: Metacritic 99 — highest-rated game of all time
news.summary: 99 on both PS5 and Xbox Series X from 150+ critic reviews, above Ocarina of Time; OpenCritic 98; user score ~5.7.

news.title: GTA 6 out now on PS5 & Xbox Series X|S
news.summary: Released at midnight local time. No PC version announced; Xbox One via cloud only. Pre-load ran from Nov 12.

news.title: Full credits published — cast revealed
news.summary: Dylan Rourke as Jason, Manni L. Perez as Lucia, Lexie Shoaibi as Mandy; Michael Hollick credited as 'The Hitman'.

news.title: Cheat inputs still being discovered (15 of 61 known)
news.summary: PowerPyx's list is the primary source; we update our database as inputs are verified. No unlimited-money cheat exists.
